description: Per-file completeness metadata for the AXIOM reference corpus. Controls which files are used for full-piece referenceDistanceScore vs. local technique analysis.

completenessLevels.complete_piece: Self-contained short work (bagatelle, waltz, dance, character piece). All structural metrics valid: referenceDistanceScore, climaxPosition, phraseDistribution, formalArc.
completenessLevels.complete_movement: Complete single movement of a multi-movement work. All structural metrics valid for that movement type.
completenessLevels.complete_section: Complete labeled section within a larger formal structure (e.g. variation theme, da capo section, introductory Grave). Phrase and cadence metrics valid; formalArc and referenceDistanceScore NOT valid.
completenessLevels.excerpt: Partial extract from a longer work (opening passage, thematic phrase, introduction). Local technique ONLY: motivicCell, localHarmonicColor, texturePattern, cadenceFormula.
completenessLevels.incipit_only: Opening bars only (≤8 measures). Opening gesture and motif ONLY. No structural metrics.
